name: family-time-capsule
description: 桉桉成长记：手机应用在 mobile/，家庭服务在 server/。依赖分别在两个目录里 npm ci。

scripts.check: npm run check:mobile && npm run check:server && npm run check:scripts
scripts.check:mobile: npm --prefix mobile test && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.check:server: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.check:scripts: python3 mobile/scripts/verify-local-boundary.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s mobile/scripts -p 'test_*.py'
